title: Pattern - Anomaly Review

title: Value Algebra

title: Errors And Recovery

title: Generated Capability Catalog

title: Generated Command Catalog
load_when: Checking generated command syntax, command playbooks, or the CLI help surface.

title: Outlook Semantics
load_when: The active surface is Outlook or a plan mentions mail, thread, attachment, reply, or draft.

title: Planning Normal Form
load_when: A task needs a multi-step program, effect grouping, or semantic turn boundaries.

title: PowerPoint Semantics

load_when: The active surface is Word or a plan mentions redlines, comments, paragraphs, or text anchors.
